description:
You are an archivist at the Industrial History Archive of Cleveland. You have processed a collection called 'The Sterling Radiator Company Records' and prepared the metadata and inventory list in a JSON file located at /home/ga/Documents/collection_metadata.json. 

Your task is to create a formal Finding Aid for this collection using Apache OpenOffice Writer. 

1. Open the JSON file to read the collection details and the flat inventory list.
2. Create a new text document in OpenOffice Writer.
3. Create a Title Page with the collection title, dates (1922-1965), and 'Industrial History Archive of Cleveland'.
4. Create the following main sections using 'Heading 1' paragraph style: 'Descriptive Summary', 'Biographical/Historical Note', 'Scope and Contents', and 'Container List'. Fill these with the text provided in the JSON.
5. In the 'Container List' section, you must organize the flat list of items into their respective Series (e.g., 'Series I: Administrative Records'). Use 'Heading 2' style for the Series titles.
6. Under each Series heading, create a Table listing the items for that series with columns: Box | Folder | Title | Date.
7. Insert an auto-generated Table of Contents after the title page.
8. Add page numbers to the footer.
9. Save the document as /home/ga/Documents/Sterling_Finding_Aid.odt.
